title: Decide the recorded compiler's predefined macros in the census's configured reading
why: W47-SERVICE-PROPERTY-KEYS reads the fixed in_tail pause test's flb_service_set call (tests/runtime/in_tail.c:218 at 90978ac6) as reaching only its keys' branches (Flush, Grace scalar stores; Log_Level, Parsers_File handlers), so the list-head derivation of the test's instance has one hazard-reaching call left, the creation flb_input at :226. The configured census reading still keeps the fixed test's 3 sites (cb_tail_pause_test :2483, :2492, :2494) unresolved on the list-head's unmodelled-call blocker: exactly 2 functions of the path's closure have no typed reading, and both are Windows-only definitions in compiled files under groups guarded by compiler-predefined macros the configured reading does not own and so keeps undecided: localtime_r (lib/monkey/mk_core/mk_utils.c:41, under `#if defined (__linux__) … #elif defined (_WIN32)`, reached from flb_config_set_property's flb_warn → flb_log_print > log_render_message > log_prepare_header) and dirname (src/config_format/flb_cf_yaml.c:550, the `#else` of `#ifndef _WIN32`, reached through the Parsers_File handler flb_parser_conf_file > flb_cf_create_from_file > flb_cf_yaml_create > read_config). A diagnostic reading with `--owned-prefix=_WIN32` (docs/reports/w47-service-property-keys/artifacts/diagnostic, never a result) derives the instance flag (no coroutine) and discharges all 3 sites on (flb_lib_worker, NonThreaded) and (input_thread, Threaded). Size: 2 definitions holding 3 sites at the configured reading (the raw reading stays held first by src/flb_config.c being unstructured unconfigured). DISCHARGE: the configured reading decides each unit's compiler-predefined macros from the recorded compiler and target (for example `clang -dM -E` with the command's flags), never guessing an undecided group, measured on the census at both revisions with the old test still not discharged; or a sound treatment of a definition the typed reading shows its own unit did not compile.

title: Count calls a macro invocation makes on the list-head path
why: W47-SERVICE-PROPERTY-KEYS found that Step B's list-head region (loop_owner_instance.rs, gateway rule 10p's W47-LOOP-OWNER-INSTANCE-FLOW amendment) and the census graph it reaches over do not follow a function-like macro's replacement list: a macro invoked on the test's path whose body calls a hazard-reaching function is not counted as a call (functions named in a macro are treated only as escapes, which matter only where the closure makes an unmodelled indirect call). The keyed setter reading this card adds does expand invoked macros (through nested macros) in the two bodies it reads. Applying the same name-keyed expansion to the whole region was tried and refused the fixed test outright on a spurious match: the test's TEST_CHECK (tests/lib/acutest/acutest.h, not read) was expanded with lib/monkey/test/lib/acutest/acutest.h's definition, whose acutest_check_ sits in a file the reader cannot structure, reported as reaching a hazard inside a loop at tests/runtime/in_tail.c:260. At the export no discharge rests on the gap (the fixed test's 3 sites stay unresolved), but any future discharge of them would. Size: the region's macro invocations (the fixed test's maker and test body, flb_create); 0 sites move today. DISCHARGE: the region (and the reach it uses) counts the functions an invoked macro names, resolved by the definition the invoking unit actually includes (include-aware, or through the typed reading's expansion), measured on the census.
